_doc: Artifact id -> location under FF_DATA (DESIGN 3). Artifact ids are the original Kaggle ids (datasets/<owner>/<slug>, notebooks/<owner>/<slug>); new stages use notebooks/ff/<stage_id>; raw/... and scores/..., pretrained/... are repository ids for inputs that never were Kaggle datasets. FF_DATA (= the Google Drive folder FourFusion_FLAG2027_data/) may be a list of roots separated by os.pathsep. The runner looks for a saved artifact at, in order: <root>/<path>, <root>/<alt_paths...>, <root>/<id> (Kaggle layout), <root>/datasets/<owner>__<slug>[.zip] and <root>/outputs/<slug>/ (layout of the team package E:/FLAG2027_submit/FACTOR_ENFUSE_c5rl), <root>/art/<id>/ (an earlier FF_WORK). A .zip is unpacked once into FF_WORK/unpacked/. Whether a saved copy may be used depends on 'class', the run mode and FF_USE_SAVED (configs/modes.json). 'private' = share only with the organisers (never in the public repository); 'voxblink' = contains VoxBlink-derived media / features / weights (CC BY-NC-SA, no redistribution); 'dev_data' = contains organisers' dev data (present only because original code checks for it). zip_sha256 = SHA-256 of the Kaggle download zip in the team package; files = SHA-256 of files inside the artifact (full); files_prefix = first hex digits only (from the layer maps, full value not re-measured). path null = no folder of its own (a stage's skip_with files are its saved copy); exclude = top-level names never mounted; verified_by = a check stage the runner schedules before the first consumer (stage.json outputs.verifies). Optional fields: required_files (top-level names a saved folder must hold to count), dev_files (left out with FF_NO_DEV=1), requirement1_gap / origin_run (see requirement1_gap_doc), unused (why no stage consumes the id), voxblink (VoxBlink-derived), redistribute.

classes.raw: organisers' data / public dataset release; always taken from FF_DATA
classes.collected: data the team collected from public HuggingFace sources (counts as raw for 13.54); always taken from FF_DATA unless the collect stage is forced
classes.intermediate: rows / LID lists / frozen features / bundles; producing stage in the repository
classes.checkpoint: learned weights or tables; producing stage in the repository
classes.run_output: a run's /kaggle/working that later runs attach as kernel input
classes.score: per-pair scores and small tables for mode (c)
classes.wiring: datasets only needed because the original code checks for them (not in the 13.54 numbers); always taken from FF_DATA
classes.forbidden: must not be mounted by any stage of the 13.54 chain
classes.embedded: small data files carried INSIDE stage code (base64 zip of Experiment/... modules decoded at run time), not mounted inputs: listed with their sha256 and the stages that carry them so that `ffrun.py dag` shows them; runner/check_stage.py compares the embedded copy with this sha256

requirement1_gap_doc: User requirement 1: every intermediate table / bundle must have a producing stage that starts from raw data. Entries with 'requirement1_gap' do NOT meet it: they are consumed by stages of the chain, no stage of this repository produces them (or the modes take them frozen by default), and mode (a) takes the frozen copy (sha256 recorded). `python runner/ffrun.py dag` and `plan` list them under REQUIREMENT-1 GAPS. Planned removal (DESIGN G18, after 20/11): a 'wiring' patch that drops the presence / row-count check of the verbatim code, proving they do not enter the numbers; or rebuilding the original runs named in origin_run.
